changes.description: Every Short's plan names its famous subject; the description's first two lines and a hashtag carry it whatever the title arm is.

generator/story.py hook_problems: a variant-system Short's hook starts 'You think ...?' and denies it within 6 words, never ends on a stock tag ('Watch this.', 'Here's why.'), and never ends like one of the last 6 Shorts' hooks; writer, checklist, editor and short_story README teach it.

generator/topics.py: a fact's source may be cut to the publisher's name (its start, at a word); source_line_problems fails a 'Data: ... · month' line wider than the board's text column when there is detail left to cut.
A round million/billion/trillion shows in words ('$10 billion') in Money.full and its TS mirror; number check rejects 7+ digits in a non-rupee title or description
A grow is capped at the room a thing has by the frame's edge (never below 1.2) and the rest slides it inward (remotion/src/studio/stage.ts)
Shorts: a big-money format told through the viewer's own money, not a named billionaire or company
